positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated 16% of the team’s codebase to TypeScript over the course of 6 weeks, increasing type safety for key modules used by internal and external consumers.
• Developed and maintained internal tooling libraries in TypeScript to enable product teams to streamline
component development and documentation, including a custom implementation of Storybook.
• Delivered features to our custom Storybook implementation utilizing internal Storybook APIs, patch-package, and custom webpack configurations, enabling HubSpot to create a tiered design system in our distributed codebase.
• Created design documents and prototypes for experimental features to extend Storybook’s open source codebase.
• Architected and implemented APIs to create a layer of abstraction between consuming applications and internal tooling libraries, allowing for long-term maintainability.
• Planned and implemented a unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategy for new features using React Testing Library, Jest, and Selenium

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
• Initiated and delivered multiple initiatives to increase standardization and optimization of frontend deployment pipelines, delivering 30% faster deployments for our React monorepo.
• Delivered features in React and TypeScript allowing us to iteratively modernize a legacy UI written in PHP and jQuery, leading to improved load times and faster feature releases.
• Led initiatives to improve code quality, test quality, and test coverage across the engineering organization, leading to code improvements across seven teams and increasing code coverage in our React monorepo.
• Investigated and provided recommendations for performance improvements, using Lighthouse and New Relic.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed website and civic engagement tools (online voter registration, absentee ballot request, polling place lookup) using Gatsby, React, GraphQL, and Redux, helping over 30 million Americans vote in the 2020 election.
• Collaborated with the engineering team to develop white-label embeddable tools for third parties, incorporating data tracking and customization features.
• Leveraged server-side rendering and SEO best practices to create performance optimized static pages.
• Incorporated WCAG compliance into new features, specifically integrating accessibility unit testing.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · GatsbyJS · GraphQL · Cypress

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
• Developed the front-end of Wide Eye’s first external React project, college-insight.org, using Redux, WordPress REST API, styled-components, and React Hooks.
• Served as lead developer for major refactors of internal WordPress theme, including conducting code review on all new production code.
• Mentored development team around best practices for reviewing and scoping features to ensure timelines and functional requirements are executed.
• Worked as part of a cross-functional team with designers, product managers, and developers to review solutions for features on existing and new client websites.
• Researched and implemented accessible development solutions within React and WordPress to address Web Content Accessibility Guidelines.
• Assisted the business development team in pitching projects to new and existing clients, specifically addressing technical needs, project scope, and timelines to non-technical staff.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed functional, flexible, and beautiful WordPress websites for non-profits, political campaigns, and foundations.
• Championed internal process improvement to increase efficiency across the development team, create transparency for the project management team, and improve the integrity of the visual design.
• Refactored portions of internal products to use modular solutions for large features using PHP and SASS.
• Managed the cross-functional team in charge of the internal product roadmap and implemented a new workflow, while also completing client-facing projects.
• Completed custom database migrations using PHP and the WordPress API.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Served as the front-end developer for BarackObama.com (Feb 2015-Jan 2017) and OFA.us (Jan 2017-Sept 2017).
• Architected and developed a Django CMS application and website, which included an updated front end, refactored JavaScript, and updated build process for the redesign of OFA.us.
• Developed a one-page survey application using Backbone.js and JavaScript templating.
• Led testing, optimization, reporting, and data analysis efforts using Optimizely, SQL, Redshift, and Civis Analytics.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Designed print and web materials for issue-based and electoral campaigns.
• Compiled performance reports on Facebook and Blog ads.
• Managed supporter lists and organized them to take action on behalf of issues on the local and national level.
• Implemented strategies to build supporter lists and maintain a social media following.

positions.title: Youth Advisory Council Member
positions.description:
• Coordinating nationwide advocacy campaigns through the Youth Advisory Council.
• Developing and running conference workshops on advocacy issues impacting the Asian American community.
• Researching policies and proposed legislation to create fact sheets and other information materials.
• Designing promotional materials for the YAC and for AAJC campaigns.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Intern in the Office of Congressional and Intergovernmental Affairs through the Asian Pacific American Institute for Congressional Studies

• Generated materials for congressional hearings and testimonies.
• Complied and presented information for FOIA requests.
• Created and updated databases of Department of Labor grants and support letters.
• Tracked congressional legislation and provided updates on labor related legislation.

positions.title: Community Organizer
positions.description:
• Strategized goals, organizational concerns, targets, and tactics based on the Midwest Academy Strategy Chart.
• Recruited volunteers and managed resources to build organizational capacity.
• Created coalitions with other organizations to create larger networks of support for the Maryland In-State Tuition Bill.
• Implemented tactics to advocate for the passage of the Maryland In-State Tuition Bill.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description:
• Evaluated and prepared information for grant proposals, factsheets, and presentations.
• Planned large-scale events such as the OCA National Convention and National APA Corporate Achievement Awards.

positions.title: Vice President of Advocacy
positions.description:
• Coordinating campuswide advocacy campaigns. 
• Working with the student government and other organizations to promote civic engagement and student activism. 
• Researching and presenting information about advocacy issues to the student body. 
• Working with the WAASP Chair to promote the Asian American Studies Program and to increase retention of Asian American students and faculty.

company.name: Asian American Student Union at University of Maryland

positions.title: Diversity and Inclusion Intern
positions.description:
• Created displays and promotional materials for the Diversity and Inclusion office.
• Assisted in planning and running the centerwide Celebrate Goddard Day.
• Developed and instituted a long-term impact survey for the Diversity Dialogue Project.
• Assisted the Asian Pacific American Advisory Committee and the Office of Human Capital Management to generate ideas to outreach to the APA community in terms of recruitment.

positions.title: Communications and Programs Intern
positions.description:
• Working with students, facilitators, staff, and sponsors to coordinate college leadership trainings.
• Created and designed outreach materials through various forms of media including the OCA National website, print materials, press releases, videos, and e-newsletters.

publications.title: Building Asian American Political Power through Online Organizing
